selection: Lowest stage then declared substage; INVALID before UNKNOWN markers; then ASCII code and canonical record-id/JSON-Pointer. Dependent substages stop when prerequisite shape/decoding fails. Internal failure prevents a trustworthy stage result and yields ERROR. Atomic conflict and unknown are composed per expression, not global vetoes.
